label: bleveMaxResultWindow setting
type: the maximum from+size (pagination window) a Search query may request, at the bleve engine level. Default 10000; settable via the manager-options REST endpoint or the CBFT_ENV_OPTIONS environment variable.
evidence: The default value of the bleveMaxResultWindow setting is 10000.
relates_to_competency_question: Is there a hard ceiling on how deep a Search query can paginate, and can that ceiling be raised?
